rows.title: Policy divergence
rows.read: USD-supportive: the hawkish hold is in week four — Saturday changed nothing about the Fed path; the weekend is geopolitics, not policy.

rows.read: Sticky everywhere — CPI Wednesday Oct 14 (7:30am CT) is the test; the diesel deal cools the fuel-inflation channel at the margin.

rows.title: Risk sentiment
rows.read: Saturday stacked escalation against diplomacy: Riyadh's airport hit twice and Trump flipped on joining strikes — but Putin relayed Iran's position to Trump and offered to broker. The haven bid goes into Sunday's reopen with fresh fuel and a genuine counterweight. JPY/CHF firm, risk proxies soft.

rows.read: CAD's oil tailwind leans back in against the jobs-miss headwind — Saturday's strikes thickened Brent's floor; JPY and EUR still pay the import price.
